tokens.name: --panel
tokens.role: Cards: roster, Ask, Catch up, Details, Connections, graph, notes, settings

tokens.name: --surface
tokens.role: Root background, dialogs, selected chip label

tokens.name: --surface-2
tokens.role: Popovers, menus, Ask answer block, invite-link box, graph nodes

tokens.name: --surface-3
tokens.role: Initials tile, skeleton avatars, hovered graph node

tokens.name: --text
tokens.role: Body and headings; selected chip fill

tokens.name: --accent-text
tokens.role: Focus edge, links, errors, destructive label, graph centre ring, stale-contact dot

tokens.name: --hairline
tokens.role: Borders, row rules, outline badges, graph dot grid

tokens.name: --field-border
tokens.role: Field edges, heavy in both themes

tokens.name: --ghost / --ghost-hover / --ghost-active
tokens.role: Secondary fills, chips, category badges, hover

tokens.name: --ember
tokens.role: The one primary action; brand tile

tokens.name: --band-divider

tokens.name: --toast

tokens.role: Section spacing on a person's page

radii.8: Brand tile, menus, popovers, menu items, xs buttons, toast actions
radii.12: Buttons, chips, badges, roster and connection rows, graph nodes, Ask answer block, invite-link box, toasts, graph controls

rules.name: The ember gradient is for the one primary action on a view
rules.body: Add person on the People band, Save changes or the create submit, Sign in, the invite submit, Copy once an invite link is made, and the confirming action in a dialog. The brand tile and favicon carry it as the mark.

rules.name: Amber marks you, and nothing else
rules.body: Only the You badge (--amber-tint fill, --amber-text label): roster, person band, members list.

rules.name: Ink is for the app bar and page bands
rules.body: --ink fills the app bar, page bands, signed-out bar and strip and the offline banner in both themes; everything on it uses --band-* tokens.

rules.name: The ember glow is for the People band only
Orange text is for focus, links, errors and the stale-contact dot
Kiln has no red
rules.body: --destructive is --accent-text; errors read in accent text; destructive controls are ghosts with an accent label.

rules.name: Targets are 48px
rules.body: Buttons, chips, fields and links 48px; rows and sign-in submits 56px. Known smaller targets not to copy: 44px menu items and phone app-bar buttons, 40px icon-sm/sm buttons and Ask answer links, the 32px Retry.

rules.name: The roster stays dense
rules.body: One panel of 56px rows, never a card grid; hover fill and focus ring move together; last talked reads in words, stale (90+ days or never) gets the accent dot.

deviationsFromKiln: Light --subtle is #6b6b6b (5.3:1 on white), not #333333, so placeholders don't read as values.
Light ghost fills are black at .06/.10/.15.
Toasts stay dark in both themes.
Page titles Unbounded 28/32 -> 32/36 from 768px; section heads Unbounded 20/26.
Menus and popovers 8px radius; no 48px or 104px radii.
No amber gradient or amber action links; amber is only the You tint.
notCanonized: Sub-48px targets: 44px menu items and phone app-bar buttons, 40px icon-sm/sm buttons and Ask answer links, the 32px Retry.
ServerStatusBanner's dot halo is a literal rgba(234,149,87,0.3), not a token.

components.name: Primary Button (Ember)
components.description: The one primary action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background-image: var(--ember); color: var(--on-ember); font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-image 200ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-image: var(--ember-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-image: var(--ember-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Secondary Button (Ghost)
components.description: Every other action on theme grounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ghost); color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ghost-hover); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--ghost-active); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Band Button
components.description: Actions on ink (app bar, page bands), whatever the device theme.
components.css: .ds-ink { background-image: var(--ink); padding: 12px; } .ds-btn-band { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--band-ghost); color: var(--band-text); font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-band:hover { background: var(--band-ghost-hover); } .ds-btn-band:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square field with a heavy 1px edge and an ember focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--subtle); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-text); box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: People filter; selected inverts to a text fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ghost); color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-chip span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--ghost-hover); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--text); color: var(--surface); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] span { color: inherit; opacity: .7; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: You Badge
components.description: Amber marks you, and nothing else.
components.css: .ds-badge-you { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber-text); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Roster
components.description: The signature: one dense panel of 56px person rows; last talked in words, stale contacts dotted in accent.

components.css: .ds-roster { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px 8px; background-image: var(--panel); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-3); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-roster li { position: relative; } .ds-roster li + li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 12px; right: 12px; height: 1px; background: var(--hairline); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--ghost-hover); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); } .ds-av { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-3); font-family: 'Unbounded', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; } .ds-name { flex: 1; font-weight: 600; } .ds-name small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-when { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-when i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-text); }

components.name: Page Band
components.description: The ink band naming every signed-in page; only People takes the ember glow.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px 24px; padding: 16px 24px 24px; border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px; background-image: var(--ember-glow), var(--ink); color: var(--band-text); } .ds-band h1 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 32px; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-band p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14.7px; line-height: 21px; color: var(--band-muted); } .ds-band-cta { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background-image: var(--ember); color: var(--on-ember); font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-band-cta:hover { background-image: var(--ember-hover); } .ds-band-cta:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

narrative.overview: RelationTree as a warm kiln-lit workbench: an ink band names the page, and one dense roster of people sits below it. Kiln at app scale: ink app bar and page bands, charcoal surface gradient, panel-gradient cards with a 16px radius and the elevation-3 hairline ring, square fields with an ember focus ring, ghost buttons, and one ember button per view.
keyCharacteristics: Ink app bar and page bands in both themes
One dense roster panel of 56px rows, not a card grid
One ember primary per view; amber only for you
Unbounded for titles and section heads at working scale; Inter as the working face
Dark by default, Kiln light grounds under prefers-color-scheme: light
